fusions.name: Closing Grip
fusions.desc: Sends a grasping current that deals 10 damage and leaves the target [Pinned] for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to enemies within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Passed Along the Line
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 28 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at maximum range. When it lands, your allies strike 20% harder for 15 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Wriggle Free
fusions.desc: Removes 2 conditions from you. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Landing the Catch
fusions.desc: Against a target below half health, you deal 12% more damage. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.
